messages:
maya: Heads-up — we're planning a VPC endpoint key rotation for our privatenet endpoint in eu-west-1 next Tue 03:00 UTC. This intersects with a KMS grant deprecation. If instance boot can't decrypt bootstrap metadata we'll see GPU nodes fail to come up. @sam @jordan @liam please chime in with impacts and mitigation ideas.

sam: Which pools hit that endpoint? If gpu-batch-eu or gpu-realtime-eu lose decrypt, queues will pile and autoscaler will push more instances that also fail, risking cost + capacity waste.

jordan: saw a couple of failed boots earlier in staging, log snippet showed `AccessDeniedException: Encrypt/Decrypt` from the instance agent. Looks like key A was removed before key B had service grants. Snip of the event: `InstanceLaunch: instance-id i-0abc... KMS Decrypt failed for kms:arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/old-key-id`

liam: Suggest staged canary: rotate key on a single warm-pool node first, validate instance-profile can call `kms:Decrypt`, then roll. Also we should ensure audit log delivery endpoint is reachable so we don't accidentally push huge S3/NAT traffic.

ops-bot: ALERT posted: node-launch-failure eu-west-1
```
2026-04-02T01:22:11Z instance-abc123 agent: kms decrypt failed: AccessDenied
2026-04-02T01:22:12Z instance-abc123 systemd[1]: cloud-init.service failed
```
(reaction :rotating_light:)

sasha: From compliance side: enable detailed CloudTrail for KMS operations during the window but use sampling for data-plane S3 deliveries to reduce egress spend. Keep a 30d immutable trail for key policy changes.

maya: Pasting current KMS & endpoint policy fragment — we need minimal change so instance role keeps decrypt across rotate:
```json
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/instance-role" }, "Action": "kms:Decrypt", "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/old-key-id" } ] }
```
We also have this VPC endpoint policy that restricts which principals can use the endpoint.

sam: Mitigation plan: 1) Pre-grant `kms:Decrypt` for both old+new key ARNs to the instance-role, 2) Add temporary `kms:ViaService` exception for the privatenet endpoint in the key policy, 3) Run canary + watch bootstrap success rate. Cost note: if we turn on verbose logs and full CloudTrail delivery across AZs expect ~€40-€250 for the short window depending on samples.

jordan: I can run the canary. Proposed commands to spin one test instance and verify decrypt:
```bash
# terraform target canary instance
terraform apply -auto-approve -var='region=eu-west-1' -target=module.canary.aws_instance.gpu
# ssh in and test
ssh -i deploy_key ec2-user@${CANARY_IP} 'aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://payload --output text --query Plaintext'
```
I'll post the success/failure and agent logs here.

maya: Schedule: staging rotate Mon 22:00 UTC, canary Tue 00:30 UTC, full rotate Tue 03:00 UTC. Abort criteria: >1% bootstrap failures over 15m OR any autoscaler backlog >10 nodes. Rollback = re-add old key grant + revoke new key ARN in policy. @liam can you own rollback window and firewall tweaks?

liam: I'll take rollback. I'll also pre-open firewall egress to our audit collectors so logs don't fallback to multi-AZ NAT (that drives cost and latency). Will post the ACL changes and IDs. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — launching a short sync 11:30 PT to confirm runbook and owners. Tagging #ops-runbook and the paging list. :calendar:
